parameters.query:
SELECT
    a.id AS anomaly_id,
    a.organization_id,
    a.invoice_id,
    a.invoice_item_id,
    a.supplier_id,
    a.product_id,
    a.purchase_order_id,

    a.anomaly_type,
    a.severity,
    a.status AS anomaly_status,

    a.expected_value,
    a.actual_value,
    a.variance_amount,
    a.variance_percent,
    a.estimated_financial_impact,

    a.description,
    a.evidence,
    a.detected_at,
    a.reviewed_at,
    a.reviewed_by,
    a.resolution_notes,

    i.invoice_number,
    i.invoice_date,
    i.currency,
    i.total AS invoice_total,
    i.processing_status AS invoice_processing_status,

    s.supplier_code,
    s.supplier_name,

    $2::text AS reviewer_name,
    UPPER($3::text) AS review_decision,
    $4::text AS review_notes

FROM public.anomalies a

JOIN public.invoices i
    ON i.id = a.invoice_id
   AND i.organization_id = a.organization_id

JOIN public.suppliers s
    ON s.id = a.supplier_id
   AND s.organization_id = a.organization_id

WHERE a.id = $1::uuid
  AND a.status IN ('OPEN', 'UNDER_REVIEW', 'CONFIRMED')

LIMIT 1;

UPDATE public.anomalies
SET
    status = 'CONFIRMED',
    reviewed_at = NOW(),
    reviewed_by = $2::text,
    resolution_notes = $3::text,
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $1::uuid
  AND organization_id = $4::uuid
  AND status IN ('OPEN', 'UNDER_REVIEW')
RETURNING
    id AS anomaly_id,
    organization_id,
    invoice_id,
    invoice_item_id,
    supplier_id,
    product_id,
    purchase_order_id,
    anomaly_type,
    severity,
    status AS anomaly_status,
    estimated_financial_impact,
    reviewed_at,
    reviewed_by,
    resolution_notes;

INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (
    organization_id,
    entity_type,
    entity_id,
    action,
    actor_type,
    actor_id,
    source,
    description,
    old_values,
    new_values,
    metadata
)
VALUES (
    $1::uuid,
    'ANOMALY',
    $2::uuid,
    'REVIEW',
    'USER',
    $3::text,
    'ANOMALY_REVIEW_FORM',

    'Anomaly "' || $2::text ||
    '" was confirmed by "' || $3::text ||
    '".',

    jsonb_build_object(
        'status', 'OPEN'
    ),

    jsonb_build_object(
        'status', 'CONFIRMED'
    ),

    jsonb_build_object(
        'workflow', 'ProcureGuard AI - Anomaly Review',
        'invoice_id', $4::uuid,
        'anomaly_type', $5::text,
        'severity', $6::text,
        'estimated_financial_impact', $7::numeric,
        'review_notes', $8::text,
        'decision', 'CONFIRM'
    )
)
RETURNING
    id AS audit_log_id,
    organization_id,
    entity_type,
    entity_id,
    action,
    actor_type,
    actor_id,
    source,
    description,
    old_values,
    new_values,
    metadata,
    created_at;

SELECT
    i.id AS invoice_id,
    i.organization_id,
    i.invoice_number,
    i.processing_status AS current_status,

    COUNT(a.id) FILTER (
        WHERE a.status IN ('OPEN', 'UNDER_REVIEW', 'CONFIRMED')
    )::integer AS active_anomaly_count,

    COUNT(a.id) FILTER (
        WHERE a.status = 'OPEN'
    )::integer AS open_anomaly_count,

    COUNT(a.id) FILTER (
        WHERE a.status = 'UNDER_REVIEW'
    )::integer AS under_review_count,

    COUNT(a.id) FILTER (
        WHERE a.status = 'CONFIRMED'
    )::integer AS confirmed_count,

    COALESCE(
        SUM(a.estimated_financial_impact) FILTER (
            WHERE a.status IN ('OPEN', 'UNDER_REVIEW', 'CONFIRMED')
        ),
        0
    )::numeric AS active_financial_impact,

    CASE
        WHEN COUNT(a.id) FILTER (
            WHERE a.status IN ('OPEN', 'UNDER_REVIEW', 'CONFIRMED')
        ) > 0
        THEN 'REVIEW_REQUIRED'
        ELSE 'PROCESSED'
    END AS recommended_status

FROM public.invoices i

LEFT JOIN public.anomalies a
    ON a.invoice_id = i.id
   AND a.organization_id = i.organization_id

WHERE i.id = $1::uuid
  AND i.organization_id = $2::uuid

GROUP BY
    i.id,
    i.organization_id,
    i.invoice_number,
    i.processing_status;

nodes.name: DB - Re-Evaluate Invoice After Anomaly Review

parameters.query:
WITH old_invoice AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        organization_id,
        invoice_number,
        processing_status AS old_status
    FROM public.invoices
    WHERE id = $1::uuid
      AND organization_id = $2::uuid
),
updated_invoice AS (
    UPDATE public.invoices
    SET
        processing_status = $3::text,
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE id = $1::uuid
      AND organization_id = $2::uuid
      AND processing_status IS DISTINCT FROM $3::text
    RETURNING
        id,
        organization_id,
        invoice_number,
        processing_status,
        updated_at
)
SELECT
    u.id AS invoice_id,
    u.organization_id,
    u.invoice_number,
    o.old_status,
    u.processing_status AS new_status,
    u.updated_at
FROM updated_invoice u
JOIN old_invoice o
    ON o.id = u.id;

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO public.approvals (
    organization_id,
    anomaly_id,
    invoice_id,
    approval_type,
    status,
    requested_by,
    requested_at
)
SELECT
    $1::uuid,
    $2::uuid,
    $3::uuid,
    'SUPPLIER_DISPUTE',
    'PENDING',
    $4::text,
    NOW()

WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.approvals existing
    WHERE existing.organization_id = $1::uuid
      AND existing.anomaly_id = $2::uuid
      AND existing.approval_type = 'SUPPLIER_DISPUTE'
      AND existing.status = 'PENDING'
)

RETURNING
    id AS approval_id,
    organization_id,
    anomaly_id,
    invoice_id,
    approval_type,
    status,
    requested_by,
    requested_at;
